description: Elisuperfici esistenti e d'emergenza - PSI - Unione Montana dei Comuni del Mugello is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.055055.it. Inter-municipal structural plan. The heliareas in the area are governed by Article 8 of the Inter-municipal Structural Plan approved by the eight municipalities of the Union and in force since publication in BURT No 14 Part II of 6 April 2022. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Existing and emergency helipads - PSI - Montana Union of Municipalities of Mugello" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Reti di trasporto, umdcm, infrastrutture, geodata, Unione Montana dei Comuni del Mugello, Piano Strutturale Intercomunale. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
